GRAPH_COMPLETION.sql_skeleton:
WITH combined_orders AS (
    SELECT
        fulfilment_channel,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_volume
    FROM
        zs_observe.increff_sales
    WHERE
        metadata_2 = 'mensa brand technologies private limited' AND
        group_level_id = 22 AND
        is_active = true AND
        order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND
        transaction_type = 'SALES'
    GROUP BY
        fulfilment_channel

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        fulfilment_channel,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_volume
    FROM
        zs_observe.jiomart_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = 26 AND
        is_active = true
    GROUP BY
        fulfilment_channel
)
SELECT
    fulfilment_channel,
    order_volume,
    order_volume * 100.0 / SUM(order_volume) OVER () AS order_volume_share
FROM
    combined_orders
ORDER BY
    order_volume_share DESC
LIMIT 1;
